item.title: UIPM Judges Certification Programme: Cohort ready for Pentathlon World Cup double-header in Budapest (HUN)
item.description: A new group of Pentathlon judges has taken an important step forward in their officiating journey after completing a UIPM Judges Certification Programme (JCP) course in Budapest (HUN), timed to support preparations for upcoming international competitions in the Hungarian capital. item.title: UIPM pays tribute to Vice-President Dongkook Chung (1961-2026)
item.description: MONACO: March 22, 2026 – UIPM President Rob Stull has led the tributes to Vice-President Dongkook Chung, who died peacefully at home this morning. He was 64. Dongkook Chung was a Korea national team athlete in Fencing from 1980-1982 who went on to coach the national Modern Pentathlon team from 1985 to 1989. item.title: UIPM Secretary General’s Message: Implementation and imagination are the key to integration!
item.description: The integration of FISO (World Obstacle) into UIPM marks an important milestone for our movement. But in many ways, this is only the beginning. The real work starts now. Integration is not simply an organisational step – it is a process that will require commitment, collaboration and clarity of purpose.
